proposedOverrides.summary: Novgorod was a northern trading power with gradually developed republican institutions. Birch-bark notes, children’s drawings and waterlogged archaeology preserve unusually vivid evidence of everyday life. Its autonomy ended with Muscovite conquest in 1478.

batchIdentityNotes.assessment: Imported Novgorod/Principality of Novgorod label, 1200 to 1492, describes the republican polity and northern territory. Independent institutions developed before 1200; Muscovite conquest in 1478 precedes imported 1492 end. Decoded 1200, 1279, 1300 and 1400 polygons reach 26 to 55 degrees E and 56 to 66 degrees N; no exact edges certified. City evidence is not projected uniformly across the large territory. No successor geometry at 1478 verified, so no link asserted.
